notes.title: 🛠 v0.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We’ve just released the v0.2.0 update with several improvements and new additions:

✨ New Features
Added sound effects for tapping, clearing, and other in-game actions to enhance player feedback and immersion.

⚙️ Improvements
Increased the speed of block-clearing animations for a smoother and more dynamic gameplay experience.

Thanks for all your feedback and support — more updates are on the way!
